text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You don't really get startled much, do 
you, Alv-san...? Even when I talk to you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Why do you have to be surprised every 
single time?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... I... people don't really notice 
me easily... so they tend to think I'm 
suddenly springing on them...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I just didn't think so. That's all 
there is to it, right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: O-Oh, is that how it is...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...I wonder if Alv-san's senses are 
sharper than most other people's...? And 
that's how she happened to notice—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Why don't you try acting like you do 
during races all the time?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you do that, everyone will notice you 
whether they like it or not. ...And they 
won't be surprised anymore.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You mustn't do that...! That won't do. 
It's far too unladylike――"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Either way, it's... the same to me.
